title: On tt*-structures from $ADE$-type Stokes data
summary: Cecotti and Vafa introduced the topological anti-topological fusion (tt*)-equation, whose solutions describe massive deformations of supersymmetric conformal field theories. We provide a rigorous analytic formulation of the $ADE$ classification of tt*-structures. Under natural structural assumptions, a tt*-structure over $\mathbb{C}^*$ can be described via isomonodromic deformations with upper unitriangular real Stokes matrices.
